about: Gate 102's Play arm (TC-R186, CT_NOGO_WALKS=play): window.Worker wrapped before the app loads; a game vs Pip (drive/play cpu-4ply), Back and Forward double-clicked 15ms apart, the move 20ms after the last step, then the reply. Graded: the engines searched (every go answered), no worker sent 'go' while its last search ran, no 'unreachable' trap. Situations: kunal761 (375x761, insets 51/31) and 320x568 (CT_NOGO_GEO). The 4x CPU-throttle situation (CT_NOGO_THROTTLE=4) was tried and dropped: the tree stays at 0 early there, but the slowed walk asks for 9 to 10 searches against the DENOMINATOR's floor of 10, so it reads OVER STRICT one run in two; both breaks red at 4x as well. NOT COVERED, measured at #553: the Review arm's walk sends the main worker ONE go (its 36 are the review's own pass), so its eval-bar control cannot redden it; the bot's own stopIdle and the Moves-view analysis worker's (anaIdle) stay green when removed, even at 4x throttle; the real phone's engine timing (device-only).

breaks.name: eval-bar-posts-go-without-stopping
breaks.why: the eval bar's go depth 12 goes out through an always-idle shim instead of stopIdle(S_MAIN) - the job's defect (#550's mA)

breaks.name: stopidle-never-waits
breaks.why: the shared stopIdle helper calls its callback at once without stopping the running search, so every caller (eval bar, bot, analysis) posts into a live search
